# ABOUT THE EMPIRE [italic]Earth, Mars, Titan. The first three worlds, and the name we carry to every one since.[/italic]
## FOUNDING The Three World Empire was proclaimed in 2088, when the United Kingdom and Japan joined their space programmes under one flag and India and a number of developing nations joined them. Together they were first beyond Sol. The Empire still holds more colonies than any other power in human space, and its laboratories and shipyards remain the most advanced.
## THE CROWN AND PARLIAMENT - The Empire is a parliamentary democracy under a constitutional monarchy. - The British and Japanese royal houses, united by marriage, reign as one Crown. The Crown is the face of the Empire, not its hand. - Government rests with an elected Parliament led by the Prime Minister. - Worlds too distant for Parliament to manage day to day are run by a provisional governor answerable to it. - Weyland-Yutani, a company born of Imperial industry, holds a permanent seat in Parliament. It is the only company that does.
## THE ANGLO-JAPANESE ARM Imperial territory runs through most of the Core Systems and out into the Outer Veil. Past that line, colonization has largely been left to Weyland-Yutani.
## IN SERVICE OF THE CROWN - [bold]Imperial Armed Space Forces[/bold]: the navy, and the Empire's main fighting force. - [bold]Royal Marine Commandos[/bold]: disciplined, well equipped and trained for rapid deployment, boarding actions, sabotage and strikes far behind the line. - [bold]Special Air Service[/bold]: the Empire's tier one special forces. The mission does not discuss their movements. - [bold]Neroid Sector Policing Authority[/bold]: Imperial law enforcement in the Neroid Sector. Complaints against an NSPA officer may be lodged with the consular desk.
## A FRANK WORD The Empire has had hard years. The corporate colonies broke away in 2148. The Australia Wars, begun over food shortages in 2172, ended in 2182 with a nuclear strike on the Australian capital. Some of our furthest colonies have since gone over to the Union. The mission will not pretend otherwise, and asks only that subjects judge the Crown by what it does here.
